It is attributed to Lo tså ba chen po in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 153,10. Cf. rNam bshad 277,7-8 de la 'di'i mtshan nyid ni dngos po gnyis la brten pa'i chos gnod bya gnod byed kyi rang bzhin no ||. de ni ma yin te gnod bya gnod byed tshogs pa 'god na mi srid cing | ya khyal 'god na ma khyab ste rgyu 'bras kyi mtshan nyid bzhin no ||
